title: A sheaf with vanishing stalks is zero
statement:
Let $\mathcal F$ be a sheaf of modules on a scheme $X$. If
$\mathcal F_x=0$ for all $x\in X$, then $\mathcal F=0$.

proof.text: Forget F to its underlying sheaf of abelian groups using SheafOfModules.toSheaf. At each point, RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor has definitionally the same stalk carrier. ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton and AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton therefore turn the hypothesis into vanishing of each abelian-group stalk.
Apply Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_iff_stalkFunctor_obj_isZero to the underlying abelian-group sheaf. This packages the germ equality and sheaf separatedness argument from the source.

The functor SheafOfModules.toSheaf is faithful and additive. The image of the identity of F is zero because its image object is zero. Injectivity on morphisms then gives identity equals zero for F, and IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero concludes.
